schema: exp03-results-v3; effective_width_controls add a widened random arm and narrowed SAE arm under the global-RMS primary. Per-seed rows map dichotomy type to balanced accuracy; ci95=1.96*sample_sd/sqrt(n).

legacy_fixed_standardise.description: Completed pre-control run: per-feature z-score, fixed AdamW weight decay 0.08, 100 steps.

per_feature_zscore_inner_l2.l2_selection: Per outer fold and arm: select from the grid by inner item-disjoint validation mean accuracy over NUMBER/TENSE/POLARITY; outer test items are never consulted.

global_rms_inner_l2.l2_selection: Per outer fold and arm: select from the grid by inner item-disjoint validation mean accuracy over NUMBER/TENSE/POLARITY; outer test items are never consulted.

random_widened_to_sae_width.matching_rule: Calibrate random nominal columns only to the SAE surviving width after the common all-zero removal; preserve SAE encoder-norm and encoder-bias marginal distributions, residual b_dec centring, and the SAE-derived top-k L0.

sae_narrowed_to_random_width.matching_rule: Uniformly sample from SAE latents that survived the common all-zero removal until their count equals rand_exp's surviving width for that seed.
